Class JasperELResolver.GraalBeanELResolver

java.lang.Object
jakarta.el.ELResolver
org.apache.jasper.el.JasperELResolver.GraalBeanELResolver
Enclosing class:
JasperELResolver
public static class JasperELResolver.GraalBeanELResolver extends ELResolver
Extend ELResolver for Graal to avoid bean info use if possible, as BeanELResolver needs manual reflection configuration.
